decisions: Serwist package: @serwist/next, as the docs specify (01 section 11, 03 section 7, 04 section 3.1 puts sw.ts in src/app). An earlier install of @serwist/turbopack was a mistake against the docs (it also needs a route-handler folder the docs do not list); it was removed together with its esbuild peers.

`next build --webpack` is REQUIRED: Serwist is a webpack plugin and Next 16 builds with Turbopack by default, which would silently generate no worker. Dev stays on Turbopack with Serwist disabled, exactly what g5 says. Owner-visible change to the build script.

Security finding fixed: @serwist/next (and @serwist/turbopack) pin browserslist 4.28.6, which has two high-severity advisories (GHSA-c83g-rgw3-j3cx, GHSA-73wf-gq98-2v4g). An npm overrides entry scoped to @serwist/next pins 4.29.0 (already used by shadcn); npm audit is 0 vulnerabilities and one browserslist version remains.
Registration was proven in real Chrome via Playwright against `next start`: navigator.serviceWorker.ready resolved with scope http://localhost:3457/, script /sw.js.
The generated public/sw.js made `npm run lint` fail (1 error, 87 warnings), so the ignore was added to eslint.config.mjs with a second owner authorisation.

Owner answers 2026-09-19: ESLint downgraded to 9 (task doc section 1, raised not picked); npm install allowed for the tooling; new branch claude/task-004 from origin/master; one shell edit of eslint.config.mjs authorised after the config-protection hook blocked it.

Move targets follow 04 section 5.1: app -> src/app, components/ui -> src/shared/components/ui, theme-provider -> src/shared/components/template/theme-provider/, lib -> src/shared/lib. hooks/ is not recreated: src/shared/hooks appears when it has a real member (components.json already points at it).
Vitest 4, not 5: vitest 5 peers on @types/node ^22 || >=24 and the scaffold pins ^20; vitest 4 resolves cleanly, so an existing dependency was not touched.

@vitejs/plugin-react is not installed: its latest version peers on @babel/core 8 while shadcn's tree pins Babel 7. Vitest 4 runs Vite 8, which transforms with Oxc, so oxc.jsx.runtime = automatic is enough.
The verifier bug fix (jsonc) is a task 000 artifact changed here because g6 (verify:arch green on the real tree) cannot be met without it. No invariant was weakened; a regression test was added.
The risk raised at analyze (I13 demanding product code) did not materialise: verify:arch is 18 pass, 0 fail on the skeleton.

g3 story test runs inside npm run test and therefore verify (owner choice 2026-09-19); no standalone playwright.config.ts: the Playwright provider inside vitest.config.mts is the Playwright wiring, and an e2e config waits for a task that needs one (defaulted).

@vitest/browser and @vitest/browser-playwright are pinned to vitest's exact version (4.1.11); the story project uses the installed Chrome (channel chrome), so no browser is downloaded. Chrome only until cross-browser matters (ponytail note in vitest.config.mts).
Storybook is written by hand, not `storybook init` (no prompts, no demo files); telemetry is disabled in .storybook/main.ts because this project is careful about data leaving the machine (D-12).
Two lint warnings remain and are not errors: import/no-anonymous-default-export in eslint.architecture.mjs (task 000 file) and an unused Geist import in the create-next-app layout.tsx.
